frontmatter.name: Kelechi Nwachukwu
frontmatter.bio: Kelechi Precious Nwachukwu is a Construction Project Manager, data science, and tech zealot with an Accountancy degree. She is adaptable, highly driven, open to learning, and new experiences. With her recent transition to tech, Kelechi has worked on projects in Data Analysis, Web Development, and also Digital Marketing. She counts among her interests - Traveling, writing, karaoke, and open-source food testing, food should taste good.
